bullets.text: Vignesh from Pallikaranai died after accidentally falling into an open canal in Madipakkam, and the office should monitor drainage safety measures.
A 38-year-old man died and his wife was injured after falling from a two-wheeler and being run over by a lorry near Ponduvakkam in Thiruvallur district.
Heavy rain is expected tomorrow in Chennai and Thiruvallur districts, and local teams should watch for weather updates and prepare relief measures.
Collector Kavitha announced that 32 borewells are being installed under the 1,000-acre irrigation scheme in Thiruvallur district to boost agricultural support.
Three people were arrested near Avadi in Thiruvallur district for grabbing land worth Rs 2 crore using fraudulent death and legal heir certificates.
Recent controversies highlighted the procurement of fraudulent AI-generated books in Tamil Nadu libraries, and the portfolio team should review digital content procurement protocols.
The BJP released an AI-generated video mocking the TVK cabinet by recreating a classic scene with Sivaji Ganesan and Nagesh, which the political team must monitor.
Hwashin Automotive India and Seoyon E-Hwa Summit Automotive India are investing Rs 1,370 crore in Tamil Nadu, and the office should facilitate this manufacturing growth.
